sasha: Heads-up: saw tail-latency regression on canary after batching-heuristic tweak — 95/99p tokens +30-40ms on long prompts.
ravi: which canary/model?
sasha: canary-3, vicuna-13b-8k.
jen: repro shows it when seq_len>1024 and kv_hit_rate < ~60%.
anya: any nsys/nvprof traces?
sasha: did quick nsys before/after. snippet:
```bash
nsys profile -o /tmp/prefetch_before --capture-range=nvtx:0:1 --sample=none ./bin/infer --model vicuna-13b
nsys profile -o /tmp/prefetch_after ... (after commit)
```
Before: attention_kernel_v1 dominant, steady 10–12ms slices.
After: attention_kernel_v2 sometimes falls back to attention_fallback_cuBLAS; bursts of memcpy+kernel stall ~40ms.
ravi: sounds like kernel selector chose different tile/shape -> fallback.
jen: perfetto shows before continuous overlap with host KV lookup; after back-to-back kernel launches with 20-30us gaps and memcpys.
anya: L2/MEMSTALL counters?
sasha: nvprof sampling:
Before: L2_read_hit_rate ~0.82, DRAM_reads norm 1.0
After:  L2_read_hit_rate ~0.61, DRAM_reads norm 1.7
jen: big delta => eviction or different access pattern.
ravi: can we reproduce locally? script:
```bash
python perf/repro_long_prompt.py --model vicuna-13b --prompt-len 1600 --qps 1 --seed 42
```
perf-ci: perf run artifacts: https://ci.internal/perf/21543/before and /after
anya: git bisect across commits touching batcher/kv_prefetch heuristics -> culprit 3c7d1f8 "adjust prefetch window to prefer fresh kvs".
ravi: what changed?
anya: prefetch_window 32 -> 96, selector biased toward contiguous ranges; increases simultaneous KV allocations.
sasha: hypothesis: larger window causes more KV allocations/evictions -> more DRAM, kernel fallback.
jen: try patch to 48 and rerun nsys.
anya: patched->48, ran repro -> 95/99p within 5ms of baseline; nsys looks like before.
ravi: open PR to revert to 48 + add tests asserting kv_hit_ratio delta < 0.05.
jen: add CI perf check capturing L2 hit rate and fail if DRAM_reads increase >0.2.
sasha: draft PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/834
deploy-bot: Canary deploy rolled back for cluster canary-3 due to perf alert at 2025-11-02T14:22:10Z :warning:
perf-ci: added regression test artifact and perf/compare_hotspots.py script (uses nsys event export).
anya: note for incident writeup: heuristics tuning changed working set, not a kernel bug. include perfetto screenshots and bisect commit.
sasha: I'll write incident summary and link traces. thanks :thumbsup:
jen: solid triage.
